answer: Exactly the task's Open Ambiguities item: 'does F6 enter this cycle?' (inventory decision #5, runs/planning/deskops-rewrite-inventory.md:221). status: blocked; do not start until the owner records the decision.

Dep is status: blocked (desk/drawer/tasks/task-rw-f6-taskdoc-contract-cleanup.md:3) and lives in desk/drawer (deferred backlog). The new TaskDoc contract is that task's own output, so no contract exists yet by design; not a defect.

Scope's discovery contract omits walk depth, symlink handling and permission errors, which decide which stores get mutated. Fix: state os.walk(followlinks=False), skip PermissionError, and whether to prune inside an already-matched repo.

No git helper exists in deskops (only `git rev-parse` at operations.py:2248, closeout.py:95). Fix: name the subject dir and command, e.g. run `git -C <repo-root> rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree` on the .sldb parent repo.

Scope does not say which path the patterns match. Fix: match the normalized absolute path of the .sldb dir (and its repo root), case-sensitively, on path-segment boundaries; note `/.tmp/` does not match `/tmp/`.

Both commands take a path arg: `sldb models update <Model> --store <store> [--pythonpath]` (../sldb/src/sldb/cli/parsers/models1.py:18-22) and `deskops desk update --root <root> --apply` (deskops/cli/parser.py:412-413). Bare `sldb models update` lacks the required model name.
Argparse precedence only; `--apply` should win over the default `--dry-run`. Implementer choice, no owner input needed.
Log layout and date format are cosmetic; any unambiguous ISO-8601 date plus a per-store before/after row satisfies Done When. Not an execution blocker.
In dry-run nothing is changed, so exit 0 on a successful listing is natural, and Validation runs --dry-run expecting success. Implementer choice.
Task already requires re-running to be safe (Implementation Path step 3); check/update/check is idempotent, so re-updating already-passing stores is acceptable.

Real gap: 'about 24' (runs/planning/deskops-rewrite-inventory.md:14) is approximate and no list is pinned. Fix: snapshot the discovered store list into the log and assert its count, or pin an explicit allowlist.
Scope already states each store's repo commit is its owner's, and Resolved Decisions says do not commit; so --apply intentionally leaves other repos dirty for their owners to commit.
AGENTS.md requires `pytest` for code changes, but Validation omits it and adds no test for the script. Fix: add `pytest` and a small test for discovery/exclusion matching.
`.sldb` is deskops/.sldb, which tracks TaskDoc (.sldb/core/models/TaskDoc.yaml exists), so it is one of the 24; other stores' PASS is covered by the script exit code plus the log the task defines.

runs/planning/ exists at the deskops repo root (runs/planning/deskops-rewrite-inventory.md) and Rationale already cites it; base is the deskops root. `files` lists implementation files, so the log path need not be listed.
